fields.title: Google Hotels rate record
fields.description: Every record carries _input, _source, _scrapedAt and recordType. recordType is HOTEL for a hotel (card or full detail), RATE for a single OTA quote, SPONSORED for a paid placement, SURFACE for a reference probe and ERROR for a failure. Prices are reported in the currency Google actually returned, which follows the proxy exit country and cannot be requested - and every price carries the stay window Google priced, which likewise cannot be chosen on this surface.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The search query or hotel ID that produced this record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

entityId.title: Hotel entity ID
entityId.description: Google's opaque identifier for the hotel. Stable enough to re-query day after day, which is what makes rate tracking possible.

name.title: Hotel name
name.description: Hotel name as Google publishes it.

hotelUrl.title: Hotel URL
hotelUrl.description: Public Google Hotels page for this hotel.

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: The query this hotel was discovered through (search mode).

address.title: Address
address.description: Street address from the hotel's own header block.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Phone number from the hotel's own header block.

reviewCount.title: Review count
reviewCount.description: Number of reviews behind the rating. Exact on the hotel page; cards abbreviate large counts (2.9K), which are expanded here.

starClass.title: Star class
starClass.description: Official star class, 1-5, where Google publishes one.

propertyType.title: Property type
propertyType.description: House, Apartment, Villa, Hostel and similar, for non-hotel stays.

priceRaw.title: Price as published
priceRaw.description: Google's own price string, currency included.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency Google returned. Decided by the proxy exit country, never by input.

priceIsTotal.title: Price is a stay total
priceIsTotal.description: True when the figure is the total for the stay rather than a nightly rate.

priceIncludesTaxes.title: Price includes taxes and fees
priceIncludesTaxes.description: True when Google marked the figure as including taxes and fees.

nights.title: Nights priced
nights.description: How many nights the price covers.

stayWindow.title: Stay window Google priced
stayWindow.description: The dates Google quoted, e.g. 'Sep 27 - 28'. This is Google's default window - it cannot be chosen on this surface, so it is reported rather than assumed.

dealFlag.title: Deal flag
dealFlag.description: Google's own verdict on the price: 'GREAT PRICE' or 'N% less than usual'.

dealPercent.title: Deal percent
dealPercent.description: The numeric part of a 'N% less than usual' flag.

amenities.title: Amenities
amenities.description: Amenity list as Google lists it on the card.

rateCount.title: Number of OTA quotes
rateCount.description: How many booking sites quoted this hotel for this window.

lowestRate.title: Lowest OTA rate
lowestRate.description: Cheapest quote across all booking sites.

highestRate.title: Highest OTA rate
highestRate.description: Dearest quote across all booking sites.

rateSpread.title: Rate spread
rateSpread.description: Highest minus lowest for the same room-night. The rate-parity number, computed so callers do not have to.

cheapestProvider.title: Cheapest provider
cheapestProvider.description: Which booking site holds the lowest quote.

rates.title: OTA quotes
rates.description: Every booking site's quote for this hotel: provider, host, price, rate type, taxes, free cancellation and the booking deep link.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Booking site name, as shown (rates and sponsored records).

providerHost.title: Provider host
providerHost.description: Hostname from the provider's own deep link - more reliable than the displayed brand, which is localised per country.

partnerId.title: Partner ID
partnerId.description: Google's internal identifier for the booking partner.

isOrganic.title: Is an organic quote
isOrganic.description: True for a genuine rate for this hotel; paid placements are emitted separately under recordType SPONSORED.

rateType.title: Rate type
rateType.description: What the number means, e.g. 'Total per night' or 'Stay total with taxes + fees'.

includesTaxes.title: Quote includes taxes
includesTaxes.description: True when the quote is marked as including taxes and fees.

freeCancellation.title: Free cancellation
freeCancellation.description: True when the quote advertises free cancellation.

bookingUrl.title: Booking URL
bookingUrl.description: The provider's own deep link for this quote, taken from Google's redirect.

sourceEntityId.title: Source hotel
sourceEntityId.description: For a sponsored record: the hotel whose page carried the placement. The placement itself is for a different hotel.

features.title: Features
features.description: Short feature list shown on a sponsored placement.

probedUrl.title: Probed URL
probedUrl.description: Reference mode: the URL that was checked.

isAvailable.title: Source available
isAvailable.description: Reference mode: whether the source returned parseable data.

note.title: Note
note.description: Reference mode: what happened, in words.

winningTlsProfile.title: Winning TLS profile
winningTlsProfile.description: Reference mode: which browser fingerprint Google accepted from this IP.

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: Reference mode: measured evidence - card count, returned currency, the stay window Google chose, OTA quote count and rate spread on a sample hotel.

error.title: Error
error.description: Failure reason: not_found, shape_changed, blocked_or_transient, no_rates_published, no_hotels_parsed, invalid_entity_id.

_rateError.title: Rate fetch error
_rateError.description: Set when a hotel card was kept but its rate table could not be fetched.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Hotels with Google's price, rating and deal flag.

parity.title: Rate parity
parity.description: Cross-OTA spread per hotel - who is undercutting whom.

quotes.title: Individual OTA quotes
quotes.description: One row per booking site quote, for mode 'rates'.
